notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l001: Жөкөр companions/retainers; канкор rendered bloodthirsty hero as source epithet, not a translator judgment.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l007: As though slaughter had struck retained as comparison to the boys' noisy pursuit, not a new death event.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l014: Бир эсебин...таба турган elliptical; English supplies a way to deal with the wolf from hunting context, not a specific unstated maneuver.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l020: Кырк чилтен retained as Forty Chiltens, the supernatural helper group. Not equated without evidence to a specific canonical list of saints.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l022: Алейкисалам treated as a name because аты is explicit; association with the peace-upon-him formula and precise entity unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l023: Lines23–26 apparently contrast the being with its dark watching eye, transformed as wolf. Literal oddity retained; no explanatory mythology invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l032: Шай ата retained as Father Shay; identification with Ali or other named saint not established.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l036: Кызыр standardized as Khizir, дубана as dervish. Name retained, not merged with Father Shay.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l038: Ыпча interpreted as close-fitting; ичинен from within rendered brought forth, exact point of retrieval unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l045: Кылайып is visibly printed and lexically awkward; line rendered continuing invulnerability statement, with exact adverbial force unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l046: Табылгы translated meadowsweet, a conventional rendering for the woody shrub; exact botanical species not established.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l047: Очогор retained as ochogor firearm, consistent with earlier weapon notes; projectile translated shot.
notes.manas-2010:p0248:b001:l048: Hand not passing through collar retained literally, although precise protective effect is obscure.
notes.manas-2010:p0249:b001:l002: Кош бадана торгой көз is double-layered close-linked mail; bird-eye image retained. Earlier Karalaevvolume glossary https://new.bizdin.kg/media/books/Manas-eposu-1-tom.pdf indexed explanation supports double wire mesh.
notes.manas-2010:p0249:b001:l003: Келеме жака here is metallic-thread/braid embroidery, not sacred words on the collar. Yudakhin exact garment collocation https://el-sozduk.kg/келеме/; sacred келеме шарып below has different sense.
notes.manas-2010:p0249:b001:l005: English Say supplies imperative understanding of ...деп in Khizir's speech; speaker punctuation is interpretive.
notes.manas-2010:p0249:b001:l006: Youngest of six lions retained without identifying all six or changing the number.
notes.manas-2010:p0249:b001:l013: Арбак guardian spirit/ancestral spiritual force; заар rendered wrath, with venom metaphor also possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0249:b001:l015: Ысап rendered sense/restraint granted by Allah, not financial reckoning.
notes.manas-2010:p0249:b001:l018: Менде understood as пенде servant/mortal; original raw preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0249:b001:l021: Зайыппуруш rendered illustrious following established project usage; not a reference to women or wife-selling.
notes.manas-2010:p0249:b001:l029: Girding-the-waist support metaphor retained though addressed by divine helper to Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0249:b001:l040: Болжош provisionally read as defective жолдош, supported by exact repeated companion statement at43; raw not changed.
notes.manas-2010:p0250:b001:l008: Five men and singular Shay both retained; no invented four companion names.
notes.manas-2010:p0250:b001:l014: Шер explicitly title lion, kept in quotation marks.
notes.manas-2010:p0250:b001:l018: Dark faith/pure contrast retains evaluative religious imagery in character speech; not translator's classification of religions.
notes.manas-2010:p0250:b001:l027: Такылдыр in afterlife-road statement is uncertain; stony is contextual rough-path reading, not established emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0250:b001:l031: Быссымылда rendered established Bismillah, the religious formula; no long added paraphrase.
notes.manas-2010:p0250:b001:l036: Барлык бирлик interpreted existence and oneness of God in immediate theological context.
notes.manas-2010:p0250:b001:l042: Forty-two times expressly printed; odd ritual count retained, not harmonized to forty companions.
notes.manas-2010:p0250:b001:l048: Кадырдай...түн across pagebreak interpreted as Night of Power (Qadr), in conversion/blessing context; exact comparison grammar provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0251:b001:l010: Speech punctuation supplied at genealogical question; no change to sourcewording.
notes.manas-2010:p0251:b001:l019: Чынзаада rendered noble-born one provisionally, not introduced as a new named person; lexeme unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0251:b001:l028: Мурапы kin-support sense, not irrigation official мурап. Yudakhin supports родич-опора at https://el-sozduk.kg/МУРАП/; source possessive мурапың matches this.
notes.manas-2010:p0251:b001:l035: Wing/desire imagery retained as wing you long for; exact metaphorical syntax remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0251:b001:l042: Ыймандаш shared-faith relationship retained in death context; burial prayer or companionship in hereafter also possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0251:b001:l048: Кат билди rendered learned written word, in immediate religious-learning context; not proof of historical literacy.
notes.manas-2010:p0252:b001:l014: Base reads бирге. Provisional interpretation пирге (spiritual guides) follows repeated formula and the independently compared opening witness in TEXTUAL-CORRECTIONS.md. This exact page252 line has NOT been independently collated. Raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0252:b001:l015: Кат алуу rendered receiving learning/text from the wise; exact written document unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0252:b001:l019: А дүйнөлүк rendered brothers for world beyond, oath-friendship surviving death; brother term expresses sworn bond, not new genealogy.
notes.manas-2010:p0252:b001:l020: White wheat flour, not baked bread, explicitly retained in oath ritual.
notes.manas-2010:p0252:b001:l021: Келеме шарып rendered Holy Word in oath context. Manas encyclopedia at https://el-sozduk.kg/келеме/ describes this religious oath alongside wheat flour and warrior oaths; physical object may be sacred text.
notes.manas-2010:p0252:b001:l029: Саналып жылдыз болжошу opaque star/companion formula; reckoned by the stars is provisional, no astrological mechanism invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0252:b001:l036: Акылга дыйкан literal farmer of wisdom rendered rich in wisdom; no farming occupation added.
notes.manas-2010:p0252:b001:l047: Эрен retained as Eren, variant of earlier Eйрен/Ийрен not silently equated to modern Iran.
notes.manas-2010:p0253:b001:l011: Кайыпча as like a vanished spirit preserves supernatural-escape comparison; present жүрү not made proof of direct observation.
notes.manas-2010:p0253:b001:l015: Ulak Khan retained explicitly as surviving youngest; source hearsay дейт remains they say.
notes.manas-2010:p0253:b001:l016: Ear/eye formula retained even though information in preceding lines is hearsay; no source harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0253:b001:l023: Окто interpreted as yoke in head/enslavement context; exact object lexeme uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0253:b001:l032: Visible агининин is defective/unclear. Brother's son is provisional kinship reading; other source passages call Üsön Jakyp's brother. Do not treat this draft as established genealogy or silently repair raw.
notes.manas-2010:p0253:b001:l041: Көзкаман standardized as Köz Kaman; source renaming episode explicitly preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0253:b001:l043: Жүк household goods piled in yurt, not a modern suitcase or vehicle load; location rendered accordingly.
